description: OrcaRouter (API key) - route Claude Code through OrcaRouter, an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible AI gateway that serves many providers behind one endpoint. Paste an sk-orca-... key issued at https://www.orcarouter.ai/console/token in place of YOUR-ORCAROUTER-API-KEY. Inference and model discovery live at https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1; authorization lives at https://www.orcarouter.ai. This preset uses the API-key path; `npx claude-code-templates@latest --orcarouter-connect` signs in with an OrcaRouter account via OAuth 2.0 + PKCE and stores the issued key instead.
